Team, Let me be clear: Congress cannot look away while ICE agents terrorize communities, commit murder, and operate without oversight or accountability.

What we are witnessing from ICE is a pattern of recklessness enabled by Trump’s administration, and we must take action immediately. That's why I am fighting for the American people against ICE abuses: **First: Impeach Kristi Noem.** I’m cosponsoring Articles of Impeachment against Secretary Noem. From obstruction of justice, violation of public trust, and self-dealing – her reign of terror must end. Leadership that undermines oversight and shields abuse cannot remain in power. **Second: Stop funding DHS.** This morning, I introduced the Healthcare Reinvestment Act to take $75B Trump pushed into ICE and reallocate it to Affordable Care Act subsidies. Families need health care – not violent, unaccountable federal agents in their neighborhoods. I also will not support future DHS or ICE appropriations without basic accountability and oversight measures, and let me be clear: this issue is shutdown-worthy. **Third: Prosecute ICE.** I authored the NOEM Act last month, before the shooting in Minneapolis. It ends the effective qualified immunity enjoyed by ICE agents and allows victims of constitutional violations to sue federal immigration officers, because, unlike JD Vance, **I know that no one in this country is above the law. ** Through four combat tours in Iraq, I never wore a mask. Accountability mattered. ICE Agents have no legitimate reason to hide their identities while they detain families and shoot Americans in the street. No more lies.
No more excuses.

clean_body: Prosecute ICE agents who violate the law | | Team, Let me be clear: Congress cannot look away while ICE agents terrorize communities, commit murder, and operate without oversight or accountability. What we are witnessing from ICE is a pattern of recklessness enabled by Trump’s administration, and we must take action immediately. That's why I am fighting for the American people against ICE abuses: First: Impeach Kristi Noem. I’m cosponsoring Articles of Impeachment against Secretary Noem. From obstruction of justice, violation of public trust, and self-dealing – her reign of terror must end. Leadership that undermines oversight and shields abuse cannot remain in power. Second: Stop funding DHS. This morning, I introduced the Healthcare Reinvestment Act to take $75B Trump pushed into ICE and reallocate it to Affordable Care Act subsidies. Families need health care – not violent, unaccountable federal agents in their neighborhoods. I also will not support future DHS or ICE appropriations without basic accountability and oversight measures, and let me be clear: this issue is shutdown-worthy. Third: Prosecute ICE. I authored the NOEM Act last month, before the shooting in Minneapolis. It ends the effective qualified immunity enjoyed by ICE agents and allows victims of constitutional violations to sue federal immigration officers, because, unlike JD Vance, I know that no one in this country is above the law. Through four combat tours in Iraq, I never wore a mask. Accountability mattered. ICE Agents have no legitimate reason to hide their identities while they detain families and shoot Americans in the street. No more lies. No more excuses. No more impunity. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. body:
No more masked agents, no more raids, and no more abuse.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260114-5812-footer&t=1&akid=5812%2E420207%2EbvOT3N)
Peter,
ICE is completely out of control, and we can’t continue to allow them to continue business as usual. As an immigrant, as the Ranking Member on the Immigration Subcommittee, and as someone who knows that the stories happening right now easily could’ve been my own, I cannot and will not accept this cruelty as normal.
[**If you’re with me, will you pitch in $3 to help me fight back against Trump’s DHS and the brutal ICE raids happening all across the country?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20260114.YxkanW&refcode=em20260114-5812&amount=3&t=2&akid=5812%2E420207%2EbvOT3N)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20260114.YxkanW&amount=3&refcode=em20260114-5812&t=3&akid=5812%2E420207%2EbvOT3N)**
Last year, Trump and Republicans massively expanded ICE’s budget. Under the Biden administration, ICE’s budget was close to $9 billion. But after the passage of Trump’s “big beautiful bill,” ICE will receive an additional $75 billion over the next four years, with much of that funding going to recruitment, new facilities, and expanded deportation operations. And that money came at the expense of important programs that actually help working families, like Medicaid and food assistance.
But despite this unprecedented budget increase, ICE has cut training standards, waived aged limits, reduced oversight requirements, and started putting violent, “wartime” language in their hiring ads.
We’re seeing the consequences in real time, with masked agents roaming the streets, conducting violent raids, detaining people only based on the color of their skin or the language they speak, and even detaining U.S. citizens for days at a time with no access to legal counsel or the ability to talk to their families.
Their actions have nothing to do with “public safety.” It’s a deliberate strategy that Trump and his administration are using to instill fear and cause chaos in our communities, and they cannot be allowed to get away with it.
That’s why I’m calling for new guardrails on ICE. We need to roll back excessive funding, enforce strict training and oversight standards, and ensure the violence that is occurring across the nation right now can never happen again.
**Until we can pass legislation enacting these restrictions, I will oppose all funding for Trump’s DHS.**
[**If you’re with me in demanding accountability and stopping ICE in their tracks, will you pitch in $3 right now to power this work?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20260114.YxkanW&refcode=em20260114-5812&amount=3&t=4&akid=5812%2E420207%2EbvOT3N)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20260114.YxkanW&amount=3&refcode=em20260114-5812&t=23&akid=5812%2E420207%2EbvOT3N)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: I won’t be silenced
body:
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.
| Peter — Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders. In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging. **Last week I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.** This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year. As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night. It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door. I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy -- because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies. **[So please: split a contribution between Roy Cooper and my campaign today to help defend me from these attacks and allow me to keep fighting to defend our democracy.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4382?t=2&akid=143%2E124072%2EMsTk_d)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Elissa Slotkin and Roy Cooper:_ | [SPLIT $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4383?t=3&akid=143%2E124072%2EMsTk_d)

clean_body: They won’t “work with President Trump.” They won’t “reach across the aisle.” They will go straight into revenge mode. | Fellow American I’m giving you a dire warning about the GOP's chances of keeping the House this year. Don’t say I didn’t warn you... Democrats are already plotting how to take the House back in 2026, and my seat is one of the first they want to flip. And let me be clear about what happens if they get the Speaker's gavel back: They won’t “work with President Trump.” They won’t “reach across the aisle.” They will go straight into revenge mode. Impeachment hearings. Investigations. Subpoenas. Media circus. Every single day. For two years. And while they’re doing that, Trump’s America First agenda gets strangled. Border action stalls. Accountability stalls. Everything stalls. They want the House so they canstop the mandate Americans voted for. That’s the whole plan. And the scary part is this: they only need a handful of seats... and they have unlimited money ready to dump into races like mine. They’re already gearing up the attack ads and smear campaigns. Because if we lose the House in 2026, Democrats will spend the next two years trying to cripple Trump and punish every Republican who stood with him. I’m fighting back. Beth Van Duyne | | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS

body:
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.

| Team -

Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.

In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.

**Last week I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.**

This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.

As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night.

It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door.

I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy -- because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies.

**My position is clear:** we should lower ACA costs, expand BadgerCare, and ensure that no one in Wisconsin has to worry about choosing between paying their rent or going to their doctor.

# ALMA ADAMS IS WRONG ABOUT THE FEDERAL DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
---
| |
---
| | My friend, Congresswoman Alma Adams recently took to the House floor to defend the U.S. Department of Education. Her remarks were nothing more than political theater, echoing the same talking points Democrats have used for years while continuing to fail the students who need help the most in the 12th District.Despite decades of increased federal involvement pushed by Democrats, reading and math scores remain unacceptably low. Parents are increasingly concerned about safety, discipline, and learning environments in our schools. These failures fall hardest on at-risk students, who are too often used as props in speeches instead of being served by real solutions.Democrats continue to insist that more federal control is the answer, even as the evidence shows otherwise. A one-size-fits-all bureaucracy cannot meet the needs of our local schools or families.Education is best provided when it is overseen by state and local governments, with parents and teachers playing central roles. Those closest to the child, not federal agencies, should guide curriculum, standards, and school culture.Rather than defending a failing system, our representative should be fighting for reforms that restore local control, prioritize reading and math fundamentals, support teachers, and ensure schools are safe places to learn.As your Republican candidate for Congress, I will work to return education authority to the states, local communities, parents, and teachers, where it belongs.Our children deserve leadership and results, not partisan talking points. name: Leah Donahey, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: No taxpayer dollars for oil in Venezuela!
body:
Tell Congress to support the Protecting Taxpayers from Risky Investments in Venezuela Act

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM0MDQ1MTcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjM4MDE2MjkzMgS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | | |
## **Tell Congress: **
**No Taxpayer Dollars for Oil in Venezuela!**
Taxpayers in the U.S. shouldn’t be forced to pay for Big Oil infrastructure — period. To stop Trump’s latest attempt at funding an oil takeover in Venezuela — with our hard-earned taxpayer dollars — Rep. Mike Levin (CA-49) and Sen. Jeff Merkley (D-OR) introduced the _Protecting Taxpayers from Risky Investments in Venezuela Act_ in the House of Representatives and the Senate. [**_Join us in urging your members of Congress to support this bill and say NO to taxpayer money for oil infrastructure in Venezuela!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Peter,
---
| | Trump’s obsession over propping up dirty, costly fossil fuels while _you_ pay more for energy has gone too far. It’s time to speak up and push back — enough is enough. Here's **one tangible step you can take _right now_ to stop Trump's attempted oil takeover in Venezuela:**
---
| | [**_Make your voice heard, Peter. Tell Congress NO TAX DOLLARS FOR OIL INFRASTRUCTURE IN VENEZUELA! >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | While families struggle to afford everyday expenses, Trump should not be investing taxpayer dollars in subsidizing overseas oil and gas projects, in Venezuela or anywhere else, instead of helping our communities. Our government _should_ be prioritizing lowering utility bills and creating good-paying clean energy jobs in the U.S., not banning clean energy projects while giving handouts to wealthy oil executives and propping up dirty, costly coal power plants.
---
| | Over the last year, the Trump administration has lined the pockets of his wealthy fossil fuel donors while the climate crisis worsens and everyday families struggle to pay their utility bills:
---
| |
* Electricity prices are up 13% and residential gas prices are up 60%, thanks to their eliminating clean energy and energy efficiency programs and attempted ban on clean energy.
* They forced outdated, polluting, and expensive coal plants to stay open in Colorado, Indiana, Michigan, and Washington.
* They halted five nearly-completed offshore wind projects that were poised to provide clean energy, lower utility costs, and reduce toxic pollution, and which had already created family-sustaining jobs.

---
| | Now, Trump is gloating that he will run Venezuela’s oil sector and “reimburse” U.S. oil companies for their investments — on the American taxpayer’s dime. This obsession with oil and enriching his wealthy fossil fuel donors is dangerous, expensive, and does nothing to make energy more affordable here at home. We must speak out against it!
---
| | [**_Tell your members of Congress to support the_** _**_Protecting Taxpayers from Risky Investments in Venezuela Act_**_** _ >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_)
---
| | The American people don’t need Venezuela's oil nor more handouts to fossil fuel execs — we need cleaner air and water, lower energy prices, and a healthy environment to live in. Thank you for making your voice heard and bringing us closer to the just, equitable, and sustainable future we deserve.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
| | Leah Donahey
Senior Federal Advocacy Campaigns Director
League of Conservation Voters
---
| | P.S. We’re in the midst of LCV’s membership drive, so if you’re committed to this work and want to help build power for everyday people and the planet, we hope you’ll [**join our movement!**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | |

---

body:
Moral and Policy differences wih the incumbent.

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=def94cfcc9&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |

# Why I’m Now Running
# to Represent California’s 2nd Congressional District
---
| | Dear friends,

With the passage of Prop 50, I now live in California’s newly redrawn Congressional District 2. I truly thought my days of running for Congress were behind me. I was relieved to be represented by a Democrat, and I expected to focus on my work as a socially and environmentally responsible business leader, and on serving as Chair of the Democratic Central Committee of Shasta County.

But at a Progressive Caucus meeting, a member raised a point that stopped me short: _Huffman should be primaried.

_As I’m wont to do, I looked under the hood.
What I found disturbed me deeply. In 2024, the incumbent voted to send an additional **$26 billion in weapons** to Israel’s right-wing Netanyahu government. The bill also prohibited U.S. funding for **UNRWA** , the UN agency providing humanitarian aid to Palestinian refugees. He has repeatedly declined to clearly denounce what is happening in Gaza as a genocide.
For me, and I’m sure for many of us, this is not a secondary issue. It goes to the heart of Democratic values. A vote that enables the mass starvation and killing of civilians - mostly women and children - crosses a moral red line. Silence is not neutrality. It is complicity.
I also learned that the congressman has not been a champion for Medicare for All, a core issue for me. I believe healthcare is a human right, and I will fight fiercely for it.
This is why I’m running.
My campaign is rooted in **People , Peace, and Planet. **
As part of that vision, I’m formulating what I call a **Peace Dividend** : a commitment to redirect a small portion of our bloated war spending directly back to the people - into healthcare, housing, climate resilience, and _direct economic relief_. Imagine an America that chooses to invest in our wellbeing rather than endless destruction abroad. That is the future I am working toward.
This campaign will not be easy. Challenging an incumbent takes courage, clarity, and resources. But moments like this demand that we show up — with moral conviction and with strong resolve.
If you believe, as I do, that we deserve representation rooted in compassion, accountability, and courage, I ask you to stand with me now.
And if you’re able, I invite you to consider a monthly contribution towards a people-powered campaign. Any amount you can give will help us build a winning campaign where your values and interests are centered.
With gratitude and in solidarity,
Rose Penelope Yee
Candidate for Congress, CA-02**

PS.** This race is about whether we continue writing blank checks for war or finally investing in people, peace, and a livable future. Please help me launch this challenge by contributing today.

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

Peter, you might have missed this news this week:
Under the Trump administration, the Environmental Protection Agency will no longer consider how many lives are saved by pollution limits. Instead they’re only going to consider how much money it will cost oil companies and other polluters.
Unfortunately this is not a satirical headline from _The Onion,_ this is real and it is outrageous. The EPA is putting corporations over saving lives. And news like this is an important reminder about the different future that our endorsed candidates represent. We’re backing leaders who will put our communities first and polluters last.
Take **Christian Menefee** , for example. He’s running for Congress in Texas’ 18th District. During his tenure as Harris County Attorney, Christian has repeatedly sued and challenged concrete batch plants in Houston over environmental and health concerns. He has actively pushed for stricter regulation for notorious polluters and forced corporations to clean up their act.
This is the kind of leadership we _need_ in Washington — especially at a time when the federal government is in the pocket of polluters thanks to Trump and his EPA.
**We’re all in for Christian’s campaign for Congress**. His run off is coming up on January 31 and he’s ahead in the polls but we have to make sure we don’t take our foot off the gas. He can win with our support:

David

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I will not give up on our country.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
It has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt. I still believe in our democracy, our values, and our Constitution.
| Folks,

If you can believe it, things didn’t stop when Trump called for my hanging. It didn’t stop with the threat of a court-martial from Pete Hegseth, either. It didn’t stop when the FBI wanted to talk to me and other members of Congress. Because now the Department of Defense has announced that it is escalating its investigation into me.

All for saying things the president didn’t like to hear.

If you’re feeling like this isn’t the country you grew up in, I don’t blame you. But I hope you aren’t giving up on it, folks.

I certainly haven’t. This country has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt. I still believe in our democracy, our values, and our Constitution.

There’s no chance in hell that somebody like Donald Trump is going to stop me from serving the people of this nation. None.

If he thought all of this was going to shut me up, he’s got another thing coming.

And if you’d be willing to help support me, please:

subject: TAKE ACTION to keep up the healthcare momentum / ACTÚE para mantener el impulso en el sector de la atención médica 🙌🏿🙌🏾🙌🏽🙌🏼
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
📱 MAKE CALLS 📱
Urge your U.S. Senators to extend ACA subsidies
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Healthcare%20access%20signs.jpg]
ORGANIZING WORKS: This past Thursday, after weeks of ramping up pressure, the U.S. House of Representatives FINALLY passed a three-year extension of the enhanced premium tax credits [https://thehill.com/homenews/house/5680184-obamacare-tax-credits-bill-passes-house/] for people buying insurance on HealthCare.gov [https://www.healthcare.gov/] , to make their healthcare more affordable. This is a big, people-powered win! Seventeen Republicans felt the heat and voted with Democrats to extend Affordable Care Act subsidies.
The bill now goes to the U.S. Senate though, where it faces an uphill battle. Republican Senate leaders haven't committed to holding a vote on the bill. We need to keep up our momentum.
https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2]
Keeping Minneapolis in our hearts
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Minneapolis%20vigil.jpg]
It's been one week since our nation witnessed an ICE agent cruelly end the life of Minneapolis legal observer Renee Good. Words alone cannot convey the vileness of her murder. She leaves behind three children as a result of ICE's heinous act.
The most repulsive part of this is the blatant lying and disparaging of Renee’s life from our federal government in response — especially after video captured contradicted the shameless claims made by Kristi Noem and Donald Trump. There has since been a groundswell of public outrage, as millions across the country are more clearly seeing how no one is safer with ICE on our streets.
TOP mourns with Renee's loved ones, stands with Minneapolis, and demands her shooter be brought to justice.
MONDAY:
Preparing for an action-packed MLK Jr. Day
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MLK%20smiling%20waving.jpg]
You're invited! TOP staff and members will participate in celebrations this Monday to honor the vision and impact of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
TOP’s fight for racial and economic justice is intrinsically linked to Dr. King’s bold, unapologetic vision for revolutionary change through nonviolent resistance.
Interested in celebrating with us? Email Andres at arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] for details on the MLK events TOP plans to attend.
TOP Tip: Don't forget about Project 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Project%202025.jpg]
Sure, 2025 is over, but Project 2025 is still very much in full swing. In the coming weeks, TOP will shine a light on some of the lesser-known, behind-the-scenes ways that Project 2025 is altering life in the U.S. (and not for the better). In the meantime, check out this online tracker [https://www.project2025.observer/en] , where you can monitor how much of Project 2025 has already been implemented.
Español
📱 HAZ LLAMADAS 📱
Exige a tus senadores que extiendan los subsidios de la ACA
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Healthcare%20access%20signs.jpg]
LA ORGANIZACIÓN DA RESULTADOS: El jueves pasado, después de semanas de aumentar la presión, la Cámara de Representantes de Estados Unidos Finalmente aprobó una extensión de tres años de los créditos fiscales mejorados [https://www.univision.com/noticias/politica/camara-baja-aprueba-proyecto-ley-para-ampliar-subsidios-sanitarios-obamacare] para las personas que compran seguro médico a través de HealthCare.gov [https://www.cuidadodesalud.gov/es/] , con el fin de hacer la atención médica más accesible. ¡Esta es una gran victoria impulsada por la gente! Diecisiete republicanos sintieron la presión y votaron junto con los demócratas para extender los subsidios de la Ley del Cuidado de Salud a Bajo Precio.
Ahora el proyecto de ley pasa al Senado de Estados Unidos, donde enfrenta una batalla cuesta arriba. Los líderes republicanos del Senado aún no se han comprometido a someter el proyecto a votación. Necesitamos mantener el impulso.
https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2]
Llevando a Minneapolis en nuestros corazones
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Minneapolis%20vigil.jpg]
Ha pasado una semana desde que nuestra nación fue testigo de cómo un agente de ICE terminó cruelmente con la vida de la observadora legal de Minneapolis, Renee Good. Las palabras no bastan para expresar la vileza de su asesinato. Deja atrás a tres hijos como consecuencia del atroz acto de ICE.
Lo más repugnante de todo esto son las mentiras descaradas y el menosprecio hacia la vida de Renee por parte de nuestro gobierno federal en respuesta a lo sucedido, especialmente después de que las grabaciones de video contradijeran las afirmaciones desvergonzadas de Kristi Noem y Donald Trump. Desde entonces, ha habido una oleada de indignación pública, ya que millones de personas en todo el país están viendo con mayor claridad que nadie está más seguro con ICE en nuestras calles.
TOP se une al duelo de los seres queridos de Renee, apoya a Minneapolis y exige que el responsable de su muerte sea llevado ante la justicia.
LUNES:
Preparándonos para un Día de Martin Luther King Jr. lleno de actividades
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MLK%20smiling%20waving.jpg]
¡Estás invitado! El personal y los miembros de TOP participarán en las celebraciones de este lunes para honrar la visión y el impacto del Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
La lucha de TOP por la justicia racial y económica está intrínsecamente ligada a la visión audaz e inquebrantable del Dr. King para un cambio revolucionario a través de la resistencia no violenta.
¿Te interesa celebrar con nosotros? Envía un correo electrónico a Andres a arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] para obtener detalles sobre los eventos del Día de Martin Luther King, Jr. a los que TOP planea asistir.
Consejos de TOP: No se olviden del Proyecto 2025
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Project%202025.jpg]
Claro, 2025 ya terminó, pero el Proyecto 2025 sigue muy activo. En las próximas semanas, TOP dará a conocer algunas de las formas menos conocidas y detrás de escena en que el Proyecto 2025 está cambiando la vida en Estados Unidos (y no para bien). Mientras tanto, revisa este rastreador en línea [https://www.project2025.observer/es] , donde puedes monitorear cuánto del Proyecto 2025 ya se ha implementado.

clean_body: [] Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] 📱 MAKE CALLS 📱 Urge your U.S. Senators to extend ACA subsidies [] ORGANIZING WORKS: This past Thursday, after weeks of ramping up pressure, the U.S. House of Representatives FINALLY passed a three-year extension of the enhanced premium tax credits [] for people buying insurance on HealthCare.gov [] , to make their healthcare more affordable. This is a big, people-powered win! Seventeen Republicans felt the heat and voted with Democrats to extend Affordable Care Act subsidies. The bill now goes to the U.S. Senate though, where it faces an uphill battle. Republican Senate leaders haven't committed to holding a vote on the bill. We need to keep up our momentum. [] Keeping Minneapolis in our hearts [] It's been one week since our nation witnessed an ICE agent cruelly end the life of Minneapolis legal observer Renee Good. Words alone cannot convey the vileness of her murder. She leaves behind three children as a result of ICE's heinous act. The most repulsive part of this is the blatant lying and disparaging of Renee’s life from our federal government in response — especially after video captured contradicted the shameless claims made by Kristi Noem and Donald Trump. There has since been a groundswell of public outrage, as millions across the country are more clearly seeing how no one is safer with ICE on our streets. TOP mourns with Renee's loved ones, stands with Minneapolis, and demands her shooter be brought to justice. MONDAY: Preparing for an action-packed MLK Jr. Day [] You're invited! TOP staff and members will participate in celebrations this Monday to honor the vision and impact of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. TOP’s fight for racial and economic justice is intrinsically linked to Dr. King’s bold, unapologetic vision for revolutionary change through nonviolent resistance. Interested in celebrating with us? Email Andres at arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] for details on the MLK events TOP plans to attend. TOP Tip: Don't forget about Project 2025 [] Sure, 2025 is over, but Project 2025 is still very much in full swing. In the coming weeks, TOP will shine a light on some of the lesser-known, behind-the-scenes ways that Project 2025 is altering life in the U.S. (and not for the better). In the meantime, check out this online tracker [] , where you can monitor how much of Project 2025 has already been implemented. Español 📱 HAZ LLAMADAS 📱 Exige a tus senadores que extiendan los subsidios de la ACA [] LA ORGANIZACIÓN DA RESULTADOS: El jueves pasado, después de semanas de aumentar la presión, la Cámara de Representantes de Estados Unidos Finalmente aprobó una extensión de tres años de los créditos fiscales mejorados [] para las personas que compran seguro médico a través de HealthCare.gov [] , con el fin de hacer la atención médica más accesible. ¡Esta es una gran victoria impulsada por la gente! Diecisiete republicanos sintieron la presión y votaron junto con los demócratas para extender los subsidios de la Ley del Cuidado de Salud a Bajo Precio. Ahora el proyecto de ley pasa al Senado de Estados Unidos, donde enfrenta una batalla cuesta arriba. Los líderes republicanos del Senado aún no se han comprometido a someter el proyecto a votación. Necesitamos mantener el impulso. [] Llevando a Minneapolis en nuestros corazones [] Ha pasado una semana desde que nuestra nación fue testigo de cómo un agente de ICE terminó cruelmente con la vida de la observadora legal de Minneapolis, Renee Good. Las palabras no bastan para expresar la vileza de su asesinato. Deja atrás a tres hijos como consecuencia del atroz acto de ICE. Lo más repugnante de todo esto son las mentiras descaradas y el menosprecio hacia la vida de Renee por parte de nuestro gobierno federal en respuesta a lo sucedido, especialmente después de que las grabaciones de video contradijeran las afirmaciones desvergonzadas de Kristi Noem y Donald Trump. Desde entonces, ha habido una oleada de indignación pública, ya que millones de personas en todo el país están viendo con mayor claridad que nadie está más seguro con ICE en nuestras calles. TOP se une al duelo de los seres queridos de Renee, apoya a Minneapolis y exige que el responsable de su muerte sea llevado ante la justicia. LUNES: Preparándonos para un Día de Martin Luther King Jr. lleno de actividades [] ¡Estás invitado! El personal y los miembros de TOP participarán en las celebraciones de este lunes para honrar la visión y el impacto del Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. La lucha de TOP por la justicia racial y económica está intrínsecamente ligada a la visión audaz e inquebrantable del Dr. King para un cambio revolucionario a través de la resistencia no violenta. ¿Te interesa celebrar con nosotros? Envía un correo electrónico a Andres a arodriguez@organizetexas.org [arodriguez@organizetexas.org] para obtener detalles sobre los eventos del Día de Martin Luther King, Jr. a los que TOP planea asistir. Consejos de TOP: No se olviden del Proyecto 2025 [] Claro, 2025 ya terminó, pero el Proyecto 2025 sigue muy activo. En las próximas semanas, TOP dará a conocer algunas de las formas menos conocidas y detrás de escena en que el Proyecto 2025 está cambiando la vida en Estados Unidos (y no para bien). body:
I completely understand how you feel because I would feel the same way.

I am genuinely sorry, Friend.
Really, I am.
I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don't donate.
I am sorry some folks masquerade as President Trump to try and fool you.
I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.
It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages. I'll get bombarded with texts and emails asking me for money but it's hard to tell who sends them all.
And if I do pitch in a few bucks, I'd probably get pestered even more - without any acknowledgement of my contribution.
It's wrong, and I'm doing things differently.
This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. [You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement - and we only won with your hard work and support.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3i53r582rrnlsku2qna3lakb0cdih8s9suihbg8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0s5jm2o75clh2bs)
Thank you for having the grit and determination to stand up to the Democrat Machine at the height of its power.
Unfortunately, the Democrats have regrouped faster than anyone thought possible.
They're ALREADY unloading 50 million dollars into enough battleground districts to flip the House. They're ALREADY dragging President Trump into court.
[In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsdp7gh9teet6bb6sqal2cpftaeo6pdlt5m3i4io_rp22sh2s8i6eor0s5jm2o75clh2bs)
If you can't afford to pitch right now, that's okay. I won't hold it against you. Take care of your family first. I won't question your Party loyalty or shame you for not donating.
BUT if you can contribute - even if it's just a few bucks - it would go a long way. Especially right now.
We have no choice but to hit our upcoming fundraising goal. Because if we fail, the Democrat Machine will crush us in every battleground district, barge back into power, and effectively BLOCKADE President Trump's entire legislative agenda.
[So I am sorry I even have to ask you this, but can you please pitch in before our BIGGEST deadline of the year?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3u37tgdbv82ddmf55ohpgsn8jhaq8ape2r97htg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0s5jm2o75clh2bs)
It would mean a great deal to me personally if you'd be willing to help.[IF YOU CAN, PLEASE PITCH IN HERE

God bless you, - Steve

Long before cable panels debated corruption and accountability, this place learned a hard lesson about what happens when government goes bad.In the 1860s, Bannack served as the territorial capital of Montana. Henry Plummer was its elected sheriff. He wore the badge, swore the oath ... and built the gallows.Healthy institutions correct themselves. Unhealthy ones protect themselves. ## Trump Says Iran Executions to Stop
President Trump [announced Wednesday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb9GOxxARS0o0tht2pQOykNfguDAc939-4z5hdT3zp17ztdjehj0GNZPs4MmF6cAV_ZABGnCZAK8YDkJY8ib8fTEQGaFSXKpGBdMtJM16N9TU1rtACTUJWjRqb7pWtn35aZNOwyqG5ypO2VV187DssDsnLSzkWqGEvW9xoVoheA9V1XTWCGG2vW8AaGELBoOFimm6jtioA2cf8cnpGqJe-n1RnTkov4o5FjI8bquysXXTXHnhRyP6JFwyYUcKZ37wSh6y242tpnMbiyw7Af9rSEzs6NlezwDYVjZkSJBJnYkyPlMUCZtj-vuZtUVDV93g_7vCP3L3lPL3wAAAP__FvuH3A) that planned executions of protesters in Iran would not proceed, saying he was told by "very important sources on the other side" that the death penalty reprisals had been stopped. Iran, meanwhile, [broadcast a threatening message](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkb2ynDAMhZ8GOu1gr_lJQZFmu5s2JSNsgZ34h9iCDW-f8Z28wa2kGY2k853z82P5QOdd3H9goJm3tER6F0_MlBeXMdJf0ie7FItFz5eLjDstspMDdAJEvxh0_l5Ua-aNSNKzpVmMw6TGXk5Ta-dNjWp6ruNA_dZLYfTYG71qseLaT3oaWjfXa50QvRDd1A0PpYwQ357b1CkSg5CN6sg4TvnxK7nIljZ_p4vyQ6fQ-tkyH6V5fm_kq5Gv3ymkilCHjXzVthasCPBO2ZtGvioYMJ6RCxyZijMUGUyK6A1wPsMBb8cWsBQsxf3fZpsJGYrFTAW0db4aBy7gTrDlFGA92VOGg2Ist78wOoSM3t9w5MRUmDKcMVNhMIRsgZP3QDrFFG7YK1QMVcofZMywYiGgC_X5KaDNszne9WsZxkZ1e0DnP03gLyV3zfJfAAAA__8daLeY) on state-run TV showing a photo of Trump during the assassination attempt on him in Pennsylvania in July 2024 with the words _"This time it will not miss the target,"_ while Tehran warned regional neighbors it would hit American bases if Washington strikes. The United States is [withdrawing some personnel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u1DAQxfGncbpZxR_JhiLFIhSqS4MQoopm1-PNgGNHtrPmvj0yr3DrIx3p9__5tr4hew7Pb7jTXFxcA9XsqRRKKycM9JceZ-EY8oa-vDgUfNKqejVCL0EOq0X276vp7OyIFOmOZnkdJ3Md1DR12zxNTikpDSq0o0ajzajvAw6DQXPXo-t4bm-9lIOU_dSPF2OslJ-0m3pDcpRKmJ4sl5guvyOHspHz7_FF6fKIe-fnrZQjC30TahFqqbVe9hzaJtRCAc4s1NJQbYzJW6GWBoOKKWSIDhIV9IwNCeygpHM_IJfEfyjDmaFy2WzCmiHHneCglGMI5MGluMMdM7VvTHC7yR9kfn0VeokPtkJ_-dzKUs3fKR1dmu1R2XvO41WY_rkj-_-G8qHwr1n9CwAA__--Npmd) from bases in the Middle East, including Qatar's Al Udeid air base, as a precaution, with two European officials saying U.S. military intervention was possible and could come within 24 hours. The U.S.-based HRANA rights group verified 2,403 protester deaths and 147 government-affiliated deaths during the protests so far in what's described as the worst domestic unrest the Islamic Republic has ever faced.
## Verizon Outage Prompts Alerts
Verizon suffered a [widespread network outage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAQhp8GOx1YEbCgSEN3aVM6RNZzM5zcIKcxT58hr5Bqm2_2_7__4zbdPEXa7u_-gbYsadrw3COWgnmi7Df8xvlVKG376mM5aCv-jhNwUC0XrRim4Clek2yCXRAB-wat0MpIPYAxzWpx4NgrrYbQe_UZ5Dj62aNe9DgErsehIVu_cSEGIbjhqpMyCDH2i-EShRLAJMdAJeXuK9FWVlzilQ7M3ZweTbRrKc-d9W8MHAN3nmf32n1JwV8VYOD2kvLFwFWzenzVYeBqLAPHBQMnJAN3YKaftLXpVSXbHfNBM7YhnRU3RhgOynCuGbgm2_A8KUbalWaS3x-e4l-j8q8ZDwu_AQAA___d7YOw) on Wednesday, leaving customers with phones displaying "SOS" mode and unable to make calls, send texts, or access mobile data across major cities. ## Report: How Older Americans Spend Their Day

body:
The South is rising again. MAGA’s white supremacist and neo-Confederate lobbies are triumphant and on the march and now Trump is about to throw them their biggest bone yet...
| | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qGk8huktWDa1nEazLzzoe3Trd8tww9xrfjIAVdXsTGq5ARRUTaeBZdDQj_ERpDP6ezaFr1jjRwBVALibfIVYpNkcVfEKcf-O3nHbb-_bCua9bQgLMdSXKIU1Kl5abvQajfuB4OfUHr9NGrbzLEBE8J2_SWVDIwm7MU8rLQgNn2ifA4jMo4lVx3n3_kHsZqjDz6AlGLrdJwY9gCHVUTdGZQ==&c=KkJ8cIrtOSxTM1fgnfE50Z53AC-R4ctrw1ziRyiciKUzPBVGVImPQw==&ch=OybhB_b7zKGjkEtOazO4CQQSbVi0UkLSnCaWSFaYDpLLF1HYAdjZyQ==)

Peter,
The South is rising again.
Trump has ordered the National Parks Service to remove any mention of slavery from our National Parks, he's attacked the Smithsonian for focusing too much on "how bad slavery was," and he is restoring the names of military bases formerly named after Confederate generals.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

subject: The Affordable Medicine Act is Here!
body:
Friends– On Tuesday, we gathered in the General Assembly Building to discuss the new Affordable Medicine Act,
| | |
---
| |
---
| Friends-
On Tuesday, we gathered in the General Assembly Building to discuss the new Affordable Medicine Act, which would establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia and immediately adopt the prescription drug prices negotiated by Medicare at the Federal level as a result of the Inflation Reduction Act.
---
| |
---
| (Left to Right: Jared Calfee of AARP, Senator Kannan Srinivasan, Delegate Leslie Mehta, Delegate Karrie Delaney, Senator Creigh Deeds, impacted Virginian Tim Barry, and Rhena Hicks of Freedom Virginia)
"I have a rare blood disorder that requires me to take Eliquis twice a day for the rest of my life. The excessive cost and uncertainty are challenging... I am counting on legislation like this to help pave the way to make medication more affordable." -Tim Barry, Impacted Virginian
---
| |
---
| (Delegate Karrie Delaney speaks on the Affordable Medicine Act)
Thank you to Delegate Karrie Delaney, Senator Creigh Deeds, Delegate Leslie Mehta, Virginia AARP, and Tim Barry for joining us and speaking on this important legislation. He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
Today you have a very special chance

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqvi0pteegq39nti4bvv2q8h8je6i4hj9tufkvb8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0slg6aob6c1h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgqedd6t888m5pcnd6vel2enhpclomp8bvsuheko_rp22sh2s8i6eor0slg6aob6c1h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_

We saw real leadership. # You're Invited!
---
The NEGOP is excited to invite Leadership Institute to host the Nebraska Grassroots Workshop on Thursday, January 30, in Kearney, Nebraska, and we invite you to join us for a day of practical training, engagement, and connection!
This workshop is designed for anyone interested in becoming more involved at the local level and contributing to a strong, effective, and well-organized party-whether you are newly engaged or a longtime participant.
Event Details
Where: Younes Conference Center 416 W Talmadge Rd, Kearney, NE When: Thursday, January 30, 2026 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM Cost: $10 registration fee (includes lunch)
Schedule Overview
• 10:00 AM-12:00 PM: Training - Catalyst for Change • 12:00 PM-12:30 PM: Lunch • 12:30 PM-2:00 PM: Training - Catalyst for Change
Topic Overview The program will begin with a foundational training on how local party meetings and activities function - how discussions are conducted, decisions are made, and how respectful, orderly participation supports effective outcomes. The afternoon session will focus on grassroots engagement at the local level, helping participants understand how party activity operates and how individuals can participate, communicate effectively, and contribute to positive results. Attendees will gain confidence navigating meetings, engaging in discussions, and supporting a productive and efficient environment. This training is well-suited for anyone who wants to better understand how grassroots involvement strengthens local organizations and builds long-term success.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: I won’t be silenced
body:
As a former CIA officer, I’ve seen democracies flicker out.
---
Derek — Several weeks ago, I led five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds to make a video restating the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders. In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial, and death by hanging. **Last week, I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.** This is on top of the FBI’s counterterrorism division’s inquiry at the end of last year. As a former CIA officer, I’ve seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can’t criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night. It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door. I always try to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy — because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies. It has been an honor to serve as your Attorney General for the past four years. Together, we made Virginia safer by standing with our brave law enforcement officers, keeping violent criminals behind bars, reducing the flow of fentanyl and other deadly drugs, and defending our constitutional freedoms. Those efforts saved countless lives. I could not have done this without your support, friendship, and prayers. Virginia is stronger and more secure because of the work we did together. My mother fled communist Cuba as a penniless teenager. She came to America seeking a better life and the opportunity to achieve her dreams. I often refer to that journey as the American Miracle. Only in America do we have the freedom and opportunity to pursue our dreams, if we are willing to work for them. It wasn’t always easy for my mom when she arrived. There were setbacks and disappointments, but she taught me that when we get knocked down, we must get back up, work harder, and stay true to what we believe. As my time as Attorney General ends, I am more determined than ever to fight for what is right, defend our principles, and protect the American Miracle. I believe in Virginia. We have a great future ahead of us working together. Without a setback, there can be no comeback, and I can tell you, I can't wait. Attorney General Jason Miyares

subject: The “13 Keys to the White House”: A Conversation With Allan Lichtman
body:
No matter the election year, one historian has the checklist down. Find out what he says makes or breaks a candidate. | | | |

| | | **Big Names Make News**
---
| “You know, there’s always a lot of attention given to the selection of a Vice President, but I don’t have a Vice Presidential key because there’s no evidence that it affects the outcome [of the Presidential election].” - Dr. Allan Lichtman, American University Professor and author of “The Keys to the White House” [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e3d1aa0bf4&e=b7b3eddce2)]

“The popular vote has actually become irrelevant, which is why I only call winners. You know, in the last 30 years, Republicans have won the popular vote exactly once in 2004, and then barely.” - Dr. Allan Lichtman, American University Professor and author of “The Keys to the White House” [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e4d40e13f3&e=b7b3eddce2)]

subject: Next Week: AI, Cyber & US-China Strategic Stability Convening
body:
David Feith joins Helen Toner and Lt Gen (Ret) Jack Shanahan. Register now for ARI's in-person panel.

| [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=4f521fc262&e=a07d75591f)
---
| **Seats are limited. January 21, 2-4 PM ET** | [Register Now](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=6bd3792783&e=a07d75591f)
---|---
On January 21, Americans for Responsible Innovation will convene leading voices in AI and national security to examine how AI is reshaping the cyber domain and what it means for US-China strategic stability. Our panel lineup will feature expert speakers including Helen Toner, David Feith, and Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Jack Shanahan. This is an exclusive, in-person event under the Chatham House Rule.
| [Register for the Live Panel](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=b4a1e15fe3&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Confirmed Speakers | |
---
Helen Toner Senior Fellow, Georgetown CSET
|
---
David Feith Senior Fellow, Hudson Institute. Former Special Assistant to the President and Senior Director, National Security Council
|
---
Lt Gen (Ret) Jack Shanahan Adjunct Senior Fellow, CNAS; Founding Director, DoD JAIC
|
---
Moderator | | Morgan Plummer VP of Policy Design & Delivery, Americans for Responsible Innovation Former Senior Defense Official, OSD; Former Managing Director, National Security Innovation Network
---|---
The Discussion Will Address | → How AI-enabled cyber capabilities may compress decision-making timelines and limit human oversight
---

body:
Derek, I went on CNN to talk about Senator Mark Kelly and why what’s happening to him should alarm every American who believes in the Constitution. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123377954/595259923/-1542703181?refcode=email_011526_cnn&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzI4MDdlOS0yYmYyLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qbkZjgGzlpm6V7fV9hjNuXbwCYO-CUQgTRp8GMN5dDw=) After Mark Kelly appeared in a video with me and several of our colleagues reaffirming a basic constitutional truth and the law—that no service member is required to follow an illegal order—the Trump Administration Pentagon moved to demote his retired rank and slash his military retirement pay. That’s not discipline. That’s intimidation. When Mark, our colleagues, and I released that video in November, Trump responded the only way he knows how: with threats. He called for us to be arrested, jailed, even hanged—simply for stating the law and defending the Constitution. That tells you everything you need to know about his respect for democracy. [**I took an oath to the Constitution in the Navy. I took it again when I was elected to Congress. That oath doesn’t expire—and I won’t let Donald Trump or his political enforcers bully me into silence. That’s what standing up to Trump looks like right now, and if you’re with me, donate today to help me continue fighting back and defending our democracy →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123377955/595259924/-1542703181?refcode=email_011526_cnn&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzI4MDdlOS0yYmYyLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qbkZjgGzlpm6V7fV9hjNuXbwCYO-CUQgTRp8GMN5dDw=) | | **[Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123377956/595259925/-1542703181?refcode=email_011526_cnn&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250,500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzI4MDdlOS0yYmYyLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qbkZjgGzlpm6V7fV9hjNuXbwCYO-CUQgTRp8GMN5dDw=)**

body:
Colorado Draws The Line is not just talking about Trump’s scorched-earth strategy to steal the Midterm elections—we’re taking the necessary action to defeat it.
| | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O84h2s6ADUaNiRKRASz-JXCE8tqnKLOio_9kFditeZaC_2ocRl87JuXZR9vHk1ZM8al44MP7eKl56xdPD61suvweMyFOyBEyFz4pS1DEv3f5PpShqURBy4CX3_o3bViRwoSlXRIU9_FjyASdUrTbdNiG-5tKVCxV63FkLx8i9_GPs6ivctVdb-27jcrKNzg9nEP6t8VXQZeq0YntTnG-qA==&c=FeEfxqJ_6NGrVMSiMH-XIhQU76n9N4OMXex-Qw5mCnf4hU7Yb9FFGw==&ch=3s6vMv-ifTkDZLCixbjovVdfcyz1-OHsjj49LRB-1lIsyoh3Zdtv3w==)

Peter,
A monumental battle for the future of America lies ahead of the upcoming '26 midterm elections. And the battle is being waged--and either lost or won--well before any ballots are cast.
At the heart of this fight is Trump's winner-takes-all race to redraw dozens of congressional districts to create an insurmountable margin months in advance of when voters will be heading to the polls.
MAGA is constructing a congressional Red Wall to prevent Democrats from controlling the House of Representatives for years to come, effectively shutting Dems out of power for generations.
MAGA will succeed--unless we start tearing down their wall brick by brick right now.
The playbook to defeat the GOP's Red Wall strategy is this:
1. Sound the alarm ahead of the midterm election. Every American has to see what is happening and know that everything is at stake.
2. Fight every GOP gerrymander in the courts and rally public opinion against them.
3. Blue states must step up and fight back against MAGA's efforts to stack the deck by undertaking their own mid-decade redistricting to eliminate as many GOP-held seats as possible.

Colorado Draws The Line is leading the resistance to MAGA's all-out attacks on democracy by executing the above playbook. Our ballot campaign to ask voters in solid blue state Colorado to approve emergency redistricting has the potential to wipe out 3-4 GOP-held seats.
Our work is drawing headlines and gaining support every day from grassroots advocates to Democratic Party leaders. We're not just talking about Trump's scorched-earth strategy to steal the Midterm elections--we're taking the necessary action to defeat it.
[MAGA has had months of planning and preparation to execute their strategy. We are behind, but if we commit ourselves to winning and give it everything we have we can make Trump's Red Wall strategy backfire on him. "Many people will die," the man, wearing a yellow hockey mask, says through a voice-distortion filter. "We will kill in every way possible: shooting, bombing, cutting. We will be as cruel as possible." According to social media posts, the man claimed to belong to a group referred to as ENDTEX.

TDLR said its employees are firmly part of the fight against coerced labor or commercial sex acts.

According to TDLR, several of the regulated programs can have a nexus with potential human trafficking, and TDLR employees and licensees can work together to identify and eliminate human trafficking in those programs.

TDLR regulates massage therapists, massage establishments, cosmetologists, nail salons and many other professions where trafficking may be present. TDLR said its employees and licensees can be the first ally in contact with potential human trafficking victims.

According to TDLR, its health professions licensees may interact with trafficked people if they are brought in for medical assistance.

Beauty licensees may interact with trafficked people if their traffickers want to alter or control the appearance of the individual to make them more attractive to potential clients.

**" Most Texas parents considered school changes as ESAs debut, survey finds"** [Midland Reporter-Telegram's](https://substack.com/redirect/43b3b4ae-41fc-4ba3-a645-a7e490e38331?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Crystal Huggins** - As Texas rolls out a new education savings account program that could reshape how families pay for school, a new survey shows millions of parents are already weighing whether to move their children to different classrooms.

Nearly three out of four Texas parents considered switching schools for at least one of their children last year, however, only about one in four ultimately made the leap, according to a survey released by the National School Choice Awareness Foundation, or NSCAF. Others said they ran out of time, struggled to find nearby options or worried about disrupting a child's academic or social life.

For many families, the search began during major life or school transitions. About one in five parents said they started looking when a child entered school for the first time, while others began searching during school-level transitions or after moving to a new community. More than a third of parents said dissatisfaction with their child's current school or a desire for a better fit also played a role.
